note: Assessment contract for Notion. This is not an installed profile and it is not a packaged recipe: Notion stays gated until the framework can send a reviewed static header and accept a documented nullable identity label. Every value below is synthetic. No credential appears in this file, and none is requested from a user for it.

versioned_contract.why: Notion documents the Notion-Version header as required on all REST API requests, so every fixture below is bound to one explicit version. Response shapes are version specific and must not be mixed.

header_example.Authorization: Bearer <integration token supplied by the user>

versioned_contract.current_changes: At 2026-03-11 the after parameter on Append Block Children becomes a position object, archived becomes in_trash across request parameters and response bodies, and the transcription block type is renamed meeting_notes.

identity_contract.documented: The page is titled Retrieve your token's bot user and states that it retrieves the User associated with the token provided in the authorization header. For a personal access token it returns the user who created the token.
identity_contract.label_limitation: The documented user object marks name as oneOf string or null, so the label can legitimately be null. object and id are documented as always present, while the remaining properties may be absent depending on the connection's capabilities.
conditional_fields: person.email is documented as present only when the connection has capabilities that allow access to email addresses, so it is never a label.
bot.owner.type is documented as workspace for an internal integration and user otherwise.
bot.workspace_name is documented as oneOf string or null and is null when the owner is a user rather than a workspace.

database.note: Since 2025-09-03 the concepts of databases and data sources are split. GET /v1/databases/{database_id} is repurposed to return a data_sources array with the id and name of every data source, and its documented response has no properties field. The older retrieve-a-database page is deprecated for versions up to and including 2022-06-28, so its property shape must not be used for a current version.

data_source.note: Retrieve a data source is the current home for the properties schema. A database id cannot be used here and a data source id cannot be used with the database route; the two ids are not interchangeable.

query_contract.note: Querying a data source is a POST read, which the current read contract cannot express. It is recorded here so the runtime owner can see that Notion listing also needs POST reads, not only a static header.
query_contract.documented: The endpoint supports paginating through up to 10,000 results per query and returns next_cursor with has_more.

blockers: A reviewed static Notion-Version header on every request, which the current header contract cannot send.
An identity label contract that tolerates a documented null name, or a documented fallback field for a bot with no name.
POST reads with a request object for querying a data source, even after the header and label limits are cleared.
